changes_since_previous_install.source: How weary, stale, flat, and unprofitable seem to me all the uses of this world.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 世间的一切，在我看来都如此疲惫、陈腐、乏味，毫无意义。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 世间的一切，在我看来都如此令人厌倦、陈腐、乏味，毫无意义。

changes_since_previous_install.source: It is far too late to do otherwise. I can't go back, not after knowing what I know now.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 想做别的选择，早就太迟了。我回不去了，尤其是在知道了如今这一切之后。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 想做别的选择，早就太迟了。如今知道了这一切，我就再也回不去了。

changes_since_previous_install.source: For a while, it is a good, warm life, for what little it's worth. Every night, Laertes strums his lute as Father and I drift off to sleep by the fire.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 有一段时间，日子过得不错，也很温暖，虽说这并没有多大意义。每晚，雷欧提斯拨弄着鲁特琴，父亲和我则在炉火旁渐渐睡去。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 有一段时间，日子过得不错，也很温暖，虽然这也算不得多大安慰。每晚，雷欧提斯拨弄着鲁特琴，父亲和我则在炉火旁渐渐睡去。

changes_since_previous_install.source: And no one within Denmark speaks of me, Hamlet, or anyone else again—save in whispers told to children too young to have witnessed the invasion firsthand.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 丹麦再也无人提起我、哈姆雷特或其他任何人——只有低声讲给孩子们听的故事里还会提及。他们当年太小，未曾亲眼见过那场入侵。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 丹麦再也无人提起我、哈姆雷特或其他任何人——只有低声讲给孩子们听的故事里还会提及。这些孩子年纪太小，未曾亲眼见过那场入侵。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I join Grace's crew, and my old life disappears into the wake of her new vessel.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我加入了格蕾丝的船队，旧日的生活消失在她新船驶过的尾浪里。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我成了格蕾丝的船员，旧日的生活消失在她新船驶过的尾浪里。

changes_since_previous_install.source: And the next, with just a slight shift—one look of those bright eyes—everything has changed.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 下一刻，只是轻轻一动——那双明亮的眼睛投来一瞥——一切就都变了。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 下一刻，只消一点细微的变化——那双明亮的眼睛投来一瞥——一切就都变了。

changes_since_previous_install.source: For years I loved a man who loved me more than life itself. A love to surpass the stars. A love which outshone even Desdemona.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 多年来，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 那些年，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I was once Cassandra, cursed to warn people and have them reject me.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，受诅咒向人们发出警告，却遭到他们拒绝。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，身负诅咒：向人们发出警告，却始终无人肯信。

changes_since_previous_install.source: He agrees the war is senseless, so I cede him his little swamp, and we end it.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把他那一小片沼泽割让给他，我们就此结束了战争。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把那一小片沼泽割让给他，就此结束了战争。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I have nothing to lose. I have lost it all a hundred times before. And in that, the nobles find respect for me.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。我早已失去过一切，上百次。而这一点，让贵族们对我生出了敬意。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。一切，我早已失去过上百次。也正因如此，贵族们对我生出了敬意。

changes_since_previous_install.source: They wonder what happened to Ophelia, the girl—not Ophelia, the queen.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 他们想知道，奥菲莉娅那个姑娘究竟怎么了——而不是奥菲莉娅这位女王。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 他们想知道，奥菲莉娅究竟怎么了——他们问的是那个姑娘，而非这位女王。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I know what became of the girl. Her future was stolen from her. She was forced to endure hell. And she came through it, alive but only half human.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我知道那个姑娘变成了什么样。她的未来被夺走了。她被迫承受地狱般的折磨。她熬了过来，还活着，却只剩下一半人性。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我知道那个姑娘变成了什么样。她的未来被夺走了。她被迫承受地狱般的折磨。她熬了过来，还活着，却已不再是一个完整的人。

changes_since_previous_install.source: From now on, my life will be focused on the Denmark that will be. The great nation to which all others will aspire.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 从今往后，我的人生将专注于未来的丹麦。一个其他国家都会向往的伟大国度。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 从今往后，我的人生将专注于未来的丹麦。一个其他所有国家都渴望效仿的伟大国度。

changes_since_previous_install.source: Norway is deflected successfully. But not forever. Fortinbras must be returned to his people, and returned he is -- for a price.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我们成功挡住了挪威。但这并非一劳永逸。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，他也确实被送了回去——不过，得付出代价。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我们成功挡住了挪威。但这并非一劳永逸。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，他也确实被送了回去——不过，对方得付出代价。

changes_since_previous_install.source: This life is not glorious. Denmark slips more and more into obscurity as the shadow of war shrinks away.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 这样的生活并不光彩。随着战争的阴影渐渐退去，丹麦也越来越默默无闻。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 这样的生活谈不上荣耀。随着战争的阴影渐渐退去，丹麦也越来越默默无闻。

changes_since_previous_install.source: He would cast long shadows on the floor, or summon illusions to whisper my name.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 他会在地板上投下长长的影子，或召出幻象，低声呼唤我的名字。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 他会在地板上投下长长的影子，或召出幻象，让它们低声呼唤我的名字。

changes_since_previous_install.source: Even if he kills me and rips my skin from my bones, or turns me into pulp...
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 哪怕他杀了我，把我的皮从骨头上撕下来，或把我打成肉泥……
changes_since_previous_install.target: 哪怕他杀了我，把我的皮从骨头上撕下来，或把我变成肉泥……

changes_since_previous_install.source: ...And for two years, I do. I linger.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: ……两年来，我确实如此。我就这么留着。
changes_since_previous_install.target: ……就这样，我过了两年。迟迟没有离开。

changes_since_previous_install.source: I take my time, a tardy explorer—like King Hamlet's spirit wandering the walls, like a fairy-sprite made of dust, never alighting permanently on anything or anyone.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 我不紧不慢，做个慢悠悠的探寻者——像哈姆雷特国王的幽灵游荡在城墙上，像尘埃化成的小精灵，永远不会停驻在任何事物或任何人身上。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 我不紧不慢，做个慢悠悠的探寻者——像哈姆雷特国王的幽灵游荡在城墙上，像尘埃化成的小精灵，从不在任何事物或任何人身上长久停驻。

changes_since_previous_install.source: We had something strong that evening. My fingers are tingling, my cheeks still warm and flush with it. I feel uniquely alive.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 那天晚上，我们喝了些烈酒。我的手指阵阵发麻，脸颊还因酒意而发烫、泛红。我从未如此鲜明地感到自己活着。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 那天晚上，我们喝了些烈酒。我的手指阵阵发麻，脸颊还因酒意而发烫、泛红。我格外鲜明地感到自己活着。

changes_since_previous_install.source: But now the future lies before us. Ferdinand was never meant to stay in Elsinore. Now he makes preparations to go to Kalmar, to assist in Sweden's integration.
changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 而如今，未来就在我们眼前。费迪南德本就不打算长留埃尔西诺。现在，他正准备前往卡尔马，协助瑞典融入统一后的国家。
changes_since_previous_install.target: 而如今，未来就在我们眼前。费迪南德本就不会长留埃尔西诺。现在，他正准备前往卡尔马，协助瑞典融入统一后的国家。

changes_since_previous_install.previous_target: 挪威的攻势被成功挡住了。但这不会长久。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，而他也确实被送了回去——代价却不可避免。
